title: Multi-Step Forms
description: Learn how to build forms that span multiple steps or pages.

data.text: **Multi-step forms** break long forms into smaller, manageable sections. They improve user experience by reducing cognitive load and allowing validation at each step.

data.title: Step Wizard

data.text: Show users their progress through the form with a visual indicator.

data.title: Progress Bar
Validation Per Step
data.text: Validate each step before allowing users to proceed. This catches errors early and provides better feedback than validating everything at the end.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Break long forms into logical steps
data.takeaway: Multi-step forms improve completion rates and user experience.
